genshininminecraft.settings.desc: Shared config values powered by Fzzy Config.
genshininminecraft.settings.fallbackDama: Bare double example from the Fzzy docs. It serializes, but it is not validated and does not generate a config widget.
genshininminecraft.settings.logConfigOnS: Write the currently loaded config values during common mod initialization.
genshininminecraft.settings.welcomeMessa: Example synced text value stored in the shared config.
genshininminecraft.settings.startupRetri: Validated integer example with bounded values for a simple retry budget.
genshininminecraft.settings.alertThresho: Validated double example using a bounded 0.0 to 1.0 slider range.
genshininminecraft.settings.broadcastSty: Validated choice example with a small fixed set of allowed string values.
genshininminecraft.settings.syncMode.des: Validated enum example for cycling through a few preset behaviors.
genshininminecraft.settings.featuredItem: Validated identifier example using a Minecraft item id.
genshininminecraft.settings.gameplay.des: Nested config section example that groups related settings into a sub-screen.
genshininminecraft.settings.gameplay.ena: Nested boolean example inside a ConfigSection.
genshininminecraft.settings.gameplay.bon: Nested validated integer example inside a ConfigSection.
genshininminecraft.settings.gameplay.sta: Nested validated string example inside a ConfigSection.
